title: stellaria nemorum subsp. circaeoides
intro: Stellaria nemorum subsp. circaeoides, commonly known as Woodland chickweed, is a subspecies of the Stellaria nemorum plant, a flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. It is a herb that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Woodland chickweed include wound healing, skin protection, and immune system support, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which are believed to be responsible for its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
